Author: Auxie
Name: AuxMarketboard
Punchline: Price shopping lists by whole stack with tax and plan which worlds to buy from
Description: Build a shopping list by search or by importing Teamcraft links, Artisan exports and item lines. Prices come from live Universalis listings, bought as whole stacks including the 5% market tax, and are turned into a per-world buy plan with an optional limit on how many worlds to use.

Author: Auxie
Name: AuxEmotion
Punchline: Auto-react to emotes with emote, expression, and macro responses.
Description: Credit to FoxShadow10 for the original AutoEmotion plugin. This version builds on that base and adds macro-slot responses directly in the Emote Reaction table, alongside emote and expression reactions.
